chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Barqi from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Hammad ibn 'Uthman said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The sanctuary (haram) of the commonly used well is forty cubits around it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the legal boundary (haram) of a public well in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the *haram* (protected zone) of a public well as forty cubits, a standard measurement in Shia jurisprudence for determining exclusive usage rights. This ruling serves to prevent *ghubn* (deception or unfair exclusion) by ensuring that no individual can monopolize a communal resource within this radius, thereby preserving the social right of access for the broader community.
